android.desc:
Vellum PDF Studio is your complete all-in-one PDF solution designed for speed, privacy, and ease of use. Whether you want to convert documents, scan files, compress PDFs, or edit them — everything works 100% offline with no file upload required.

🔒 Your files stay on your device. No cloud storage. No tracking. Full privacy.

🚀 Key Features
📄 Word to PDF Converter

Convert Word documents to high-quality PDFs instantly
• Supports DOC & DOCX files
• Fast conversion without internet
• Maintains formatting perfectly

📷 Scan Camera to PDF

Turn your phone into a powerful document scanner
• Scan documents using camera
• Auto edge detection
• Enhance image quality
• Save scans directly as PDF

📦 PDF Compressor

Reduce PDF file size without losing quality
• Multiple compression levels
• Save storage space
• Share files easily

🔗 PDF Merger

Combine multiple PDFs into one file
• Rearrange pages easily
• Merge unlimited documents
• Simple and fast processing

✏️ PDF Editor

Edit your PDFs anytime, anywhere
• Add text to PDF
• Annotate documents
• Highlight important sections
• Sign documents digitally

🔒 100% Offline & Secure

Unlike other apps, Vellum PDF Studio works completely offline
• No internet required
• No data upload
• No cloud storage
• Full control over your files

Perfect for users who care about privacy and security

⚡ Why Choose Vellum PDF Studio?

✔ All-in-one PDF toolkit
✔ Lightweight & fast performance
✔ Clean and simple UI
✔ No ads interruption (if applicable)
✔ Works on low-end devices
✔ Designed for students, professionals & businesses

🎯 Perfect For

• Students converting assignments
• Office work & document management
• Scanning notes & receipts
• Freelancers & business users
